sentences.text:
2. Respondent No.2 lodged an FIR which came to be registered in Crime No.40/2018 by the Jayprakash nAGAR Police Station for the offences punishable under Section 420 of the IPC read with Section 66(C) and 66(D) of Information Technology Act, 2000 and Section 63 of the Copy Right Act, 1957 (for short 'Copy Right Act').
3.

The allegation made in the said complaint was that respondent No.2 has created software which is now being used by the petitioners and as such, there is a violation of the above provisions and it is in that background that action was requested to be initiated under the Copy Right Act.
4. The petitioners have also filed a suit in O.S.No.2731/2018 against the respondents and its officers for declaration that it is the owner of the subject software in the said suit.

The matter having been referred to mediation, the NC: 2024:KHC:10917 parties have entered into a settlement on 03.04.2021 where under the defendants have confirmed the ownership of the plaintiffs as regards the said software and that the defendants would not have any claim on the said software.
5. That being so, the allegation which had been made in the complaint that the software developed by respondent No.2 had been unauthorizedly used by the petitioners
The offences alleged are essentially civil in nature, in view of a commercial dispute between the parties.
As such, I am of the considered opinion that, both in law as also in facts, taking into consideration the settlement arrived between the parties, the criminal proceedings cannot go on.

As such, I pass the following:
::ORDER::
i) The criminal petition is allowed.
ii) The FIR in Crime No.40/2018 registered by the Jayaprakash Nagara Police Station, Bengaluru for the offence punishable under Section 420 of the IPC read with Section 66(C) and 66(D) of NC: 2024:KHC:10917 Information Technology Act, 2000 and Section 63 of the Copy Right Act, 1957 pending on the file of the I Additional ACMM, Bengaluru as also the charge sheet bearing C.C.No.16665/2023 are hereby quashed.
iii) In view of dismissal of the main petition, I.A.No.2/2024 does not survive for consideration and the same stands disposed of.
Sd/-
